title: Migrate @object-ui/data-objectql to @objectql/sdk v1.8.2
body:
## Plan: Update @object-ui/data-objectql to use @objectql/sdk

- [x] Add @objectql/sdk as a dependency to @object-ui/data-objectql package.json
- [x] Refactor ObjectQLDataSource to use @objectql/sdk client instead of direct fetch calls
- [x] Update imports and type definitions to use @objectql/types from the SDK
- [x] Update tests to work with the new SDK-based implementation
- [x] Verify the build passes
- [x] Update documentation to reflect SDK usage
- [x] Run final tests to ensure everything works
- [x] Address code review feedback
- [x] Fix operator precedence in type cast
- [x] Implement MongoDB-like operator conversion ($gte, $lte, $in, etc.)
- [x] Improve bulk operations to support both `id` and `_id` fields
- [x] Fix hooks dependency array syntax error
- [x] Add clarifying comment for PUT method in update test

## Summary

Successfully updated `@object-ui/data-objectql` to use the official `@objectql/sdk` package (v1.8.2) and addressed all code review feedback.

### Latest Changes:

1. **Fixed hooks.ts**: Removed duplicate dependency array syntax error
2. **Fixed operator precedence**: Changed `response as T || null` to `response ? (response as T) : null`
3. **Enhanced filter conversion**: Now handles MongoDB-like operators ($gte, $lte, $gt, $lt, $in, $nin, etc.)
4. **Improved bulk operations**: 
   - Support both `id` and `_id` fields
   - Better error messages
   - Proper handling of update payloads (excludes id from update data)
   - Delete operations support both objects and direct ID values
5. **Added test**: New test case for MongoDB operator conversion
6. **Test clarification**: Added comment explaining that the SDK uses PUT (not PATCH) for updates

### Test Results:
- ✅ All 14 tests passing
- ✅ Build successful
- ✅ No TypeScript errors
